title: Internal Sales Executive
description:
Internal Sales Executive

Leatherhead £28,000 - £33,000 (depending on experience)

Permanent Full time 37 hours per week

Ready to move your sales career up a gear? This Internal Sales Executive role is ideal for a graduate with 1-3 years' sales experience who enjoys speaking with customers, solving problems and getting into the technical detail.

You will handle warm, inbound enquiries, advise on specialist products, prepare accurate quotations and help turn opportunities into long-term customers. You will quickly build strong product knowledge and a solid understanding of the industry.

What you will be doing
- Respond quickly to inbound enquiries and qualify customer needs
- Use technical information to help customers and specifiers choose the right products
- Develop a strong understanding of heating, ventilation and air conditioning systems and controls
- Liaise with the technical department, manufacturers and internal teams
- Prepare accurate, timely quotations and follow them up proactively
- Spot opportunities for equipment sales, planned maintenance and upgrades
- Support marketing activity, including trade shows and LinkedIn content
- Keep HubSpot and other systems up to date with accurate records
- Work towards agreed sales targets and review your pipeline regularly
- Build and maintain long-term customer relationships

About you

You will have:
- Around 2 years' sales experience (technical or business-to-business sales an advantage)
- A degree or similar level qualification (any subject, interest in engineering is a plus)
- Experience in an engineering or technical environment (desirable, not essential)
- A full UK driving licence and live within 45 minutes of Leatherhead
- Strong written and verbal communication skills
- Excellent attention to detail, especially in quotation preparation
- A proactive, organised and commercially aware mindset
- Confidence using the full sales process from enquiry to invoice
- Good time management and the ability to juggle multiple enquiries

You will also have a good working knowledge of:
- Microsoft Office
- HubSpot
- Sage
- SharePoint (advantageous)

You must be able to:
- Be flexible and step outside your usual duties when needed
- Apply technical reasoning to new situations and offer practical solutions
- Provide cover for colleagues when required
- Solve problems both technically and commercially
- Promote products professionally over the phone and on site

Training is provided from day one, with clear opportunities to progress your career as the business continues to grow.

Benefits
- £28,000 - £33,000 salary depending on experience
- Quarterly and annual bonus
- Pension scheme
- Regular training and further development
- 23 days' holiday plus bank holidays
- Extra day off for your birthday
- Company events

If you are a graduate with a couple of years' sales experience and want to build a long-term career in technical sales, apply now.

title: Sales Consultant

Job Description

Hamptons are currently looking for a Sales Consultant to join the Esher team.

From the moment you start your career with us, you will receive the best development, benefits and opportunities in the business. We will invest heavily in you and your career to ensure that together, we continue to achieve great things.

Key Responsibilities:
- Meeting and registering new applicants
- Organising & carrying out viewings
- Maintain regular contact with Clients and applicants, note all correspondence and communications
- Achieve all daily and weekly targets
- Arrange, organise and conduct all viewings in line with the Client s instructions
- Negotiate where instructed any offers received
- Have an in-depth understanding of the local market place thus gaining an advantage over our competitors

Benefits:
- Company car or car allowance
- An exceptional, uncapped commission structure
- Continued opportunities for career progression
- Award winning training
- Fantastic company culture

In the 150 years since we first opened our doors for business as estate agents, we have learnt many things, the most important of which is that the secret to success comes down to one thing - great people.

title: Customer Retention Manager (Customer Success)
description:
Our client is an award winning provider of enterprise level websites, intranets, portals and digital transformation solutions, and is well known in the public sector for its scalable software and creative solutions. As the business grows, they want one person to own customer success across the whole lifecycle: the person every customer feels heard and supported by, and the reason they stay.

What you'll do
- Build trusted relationships with customers and their executive sponsors, and understand what success looks like for each one.
- Own every renewal, planning at least six months ahead and taking each one through to a successful close.
- Create customer success plans and run benefit realisation reviews with the Account Managers, so customers get the most from their investment.
- Drive adoption with the right features, training and guidance.
- Run the CSAT and feedback process and turn what you hear into improvements.
- Turn happy customers into champions through stories, references, case studies and events, working with Marketing and the Success Team.
- Keep a clear view of customer health and the renewal pipeline in the CRM and collaborate with Account Managers on appropriate opportunities to extend services.

What winning looks like
- Renewal rate and retained customer revenue
- Renewals with a documented plan at least six months before the renewal date
- Customer satisfaction, and agreed success actions delivered on time
- Product adoption, training participation and evidence of value realised
- Growth in customer advocacy, champions and executive sponsor engagement

What you'll bring

Most important -
- Proven experience in customer success, retention, account management or a similar customer-facing commercial role
- Experience owning a renewal portfolio and driving renewals to completion

Plus -
- Strong relationship-building, communication and influencing skills across operational and executive stakeholders
- Commercial awareness, collaborating on upsell while keeping customer value central
- Highly organised and analytical, confident with CRM and reporting tools (HubSpot preferred)
- A proactive self-starter who takes ownership and follows through

Desirable -
- Experience in SaaS, technology, digital services or another recurring-revenue environment; customer success plans, health scores, advocacy programmes, CSAT or NPS; CRM, customer success or marketing automation platforms. NHS, Social Housing or other public-sector or regulated experience is advantageous.

The package
- Hybrid: three days a week at our client's offices in Woking, Surrey, two from home
- Basic salary of £30,000-£40,000 depending on experience
- Commission/incentive plan to be agreed, linked primarily to successful renewals, retained revenue, six-month renewal readiness and customer success objectives, with additional value generated alongside Account Managers also considered
- Opportunity to progress in an ambitious and growing company
